sql: select 'live' src, strategy tag, count(*)::text n, count(distinct market_ticker)::text mkts, sum(case when market_ticker like 'KXTRUMPMENTION%' then 1 else 0 end)::text trump, max(created_at)::text last from live_orders where created_at >= '2026-10-30 13:43+00' and strategy in ('Xmmsell10','Ymmsell10','Kmmsell10','Vmmsell10') group by strategy union all select 'paper', strategy, count(*)::text, count(distinct market_ticker)::text, sum(case when market_ticker like 'KXTRUMPMENTION%' then 1 else 0 end)::text, max(created_at)::text from paper_trades where created_at >= '2026-10-30 13:43+00' and strategy in ('Xmmsell10_pt4','Ymmsell10_pt4','Smmsell10','Zmmsell10') group by strategy union all select 'parity:' || coalesce(live_outcome,'-'), live_tag, count(*)::text, count(distinct market_ticker)::text, '', max(recorded_at)::text from live_paper_parity_events where recorded_at >= '2026-10-30 13:43+00' and live_tag in ('Xmmsell10','Ymmsell10') group by 1,2 union all select 'twin_row', twin_tag, '1', '', '', coalesce(ended_at::text, 'open since ' || started_at::text) from live_paper_twins where live_tag in ('Xmmsell10','Ymmsell10') union all select 'integrity:' || kind, coalesce(resolved_at::text,'UNRESOLVED'), count(*)::text, '', '', max(detected_at)::text from experiment_integrity_events where detected_at >= '2026-10-30 13:44+00' group by kind, resolved_at is null, resolved_at order by 1, 2
